year.flowers: One white flower per stem, often pink underneath, with six petals and a yellow middle. In southern Finland from late April to May.
year.fruit: A small nodding head of tiny green seeds in June; ants carry the seeds away.
year.notes: 10-25 cm tall, with three deeply cut leaves in a ring halfway up the stem. Grows in white carpets in leafy groves and herb-rich spruce forest, flowering before the trees come into leaf; the leaves wither by midsummer and the plant waits underground until next spring. Poisonous if eaten.
